import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { area } from "./area";
import { areaTagRaw } from "./area_tag_raw";

export const editor = defineTable("editor", {
    columns: {
        id: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        name: col.varchar(64).notNull(),
        privs: col.integer().default(0),
        email: col.varchar(64),
        website: col.varchar(),
        bio: col.text(),
        memberSince: col.timestamptz().onCreateNow(),
        emailConfirmDate: col.timestamptz(),
        lastLoginDate: col.timestamptz().onCreateNow(),
        lastUpdated: col.timestamptz().onCreateNow(),
        birthDate: col.date(),
        gender: col.integer(),
        area: col.integer(),
        password: col.varchar(128).notNull(),
        ha1: col.char(32).column("ha1").notNull(),
        deleted: col.boolean().notNull().default(false)
    },
    relations: {
        areaRelation: rel.belongsTo(() => area, { localKey: "area", onDelete: "no action" }),
        area_tag_raw: rel.hasMany(() => areaTagRaw, { foreignKey: "editor" })
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
